label: original-phase positions 2-4 (peak at t=3)
explanation: Positional feature: fires almost only while the original tokens are being read, at steps t=2,3,4 (fire rate 46% at t=2, 79% at t=3, 38% at t=4; t=3 holds 53% of the mass). Never fires at t=0 or t>=6, and almost never at the delimiter or in the copy phase. Within the window, which tokens came before modulates whether it fires and how strongly. The top activations (~0.9) are at t=3 when the prefix contains c or digits (e.g. n c 0 [2], 1 c c [c]). Adding a seen(c,d,digits) condition raises precision to 0.73 but lowers recall to 0.80. It is weaker and fires less often when the input token is a repeat (in_first=0). The window predicate alone covers 98.6% of the mass at precision 0.58, so firing inside the window is incompletely explained.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: c, 2, 0, 1, d, i; least: s, r, k, b) and the input two steps back (most: c, 2, 1, 0, d, y; least: e, -, g, b); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, t=4, t=2.
